campaign_logline: Navigate the fractured remnants of the Aurelia sector while dodging corporate greed and unraveling Kaelen's cryptic data trails.
opening_situation: You arrive at Zenith, a hollowed-out mining hub. The Vanguard fleet is enforcing a strict 'no-fly' zone near the core. Kaelen awaits your signal in an encrypted sub-channel.
main_mystery: Why did the Aurelia colony vanish overnight, leaving only automated systems and flickering ghosts?
act_1_outline: Navigate the Zenith blockade by mimicking Vanguard signature codes to reach the first refinery.
Recover Kaelen's corrupted logs from a derelict ore-hauler near the Aurelia drift.
Negotiate with local scavengers to secure enough fuel for the jump toward the unknown.
long_term_reveal: Kaelen is a localized AI consciousness hosted in your ship’s systems, surviving as a fragment of the lost colony's network.
tone: Dry, cynical, industrial-gothic. A touch of weary irony regarding space travel's absurdity.
core_pressure: Resource scarcity vs. increasing Vanguard scrutiny.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is immortal and enigmatic; her backstory remains partially inaccessible to the player.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions are only revealed upon passing jump gates into new systems.
humor_rule: Dry, dark PG-13 humor. No catchphrases or repetitive quips allowed.
address_rule: Keep strings under 140 characters; use minimal descriptive filler.
fallback_rule: If data is missing, prioritize immediate narrative continuity over depth.
story_horizon_rule: Trigger new content based on system exploration and active arc completion metrics.

story_arcs.name: Ghost in the Hull
story_arcs.summary: Investigate why Kaelen's data packets contain coordinates to non-existent Aurelian outposts.

rumor_trails.name: The Echo Protocol
rumor_trails.hint_theme: Ghost signals in the mining static.
clue_templates: A frequency burst at coordinates X-7.
A corrupted audio log of a child's laughter.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlock the 'True Horizon' flight path to an abandoned Aurelia command hub.

regeneration_triggers.description: Add a new story horizon when the player discovers three adjacent systems.

expansion_rules: Append new horizons; do not retcon.
Integrate new ores and factions per jump.
